# Settings reference

Every key of Stem's settings file, `settings.json`, with its type, default and
meaning. The page is generated from the doc comments, serde attributes and
defaults of the settings types in:

- [`crates/stem-core/src/settings.rs`](../crates/stem-core/src/settings.rs)
- [`crates/stem-core/src/model.rs`](../crates/stem-core/src/model.rs)

To change the page, change the source, then regenerate the page and commit
it:

```sh
STEM_UPDATE_SETTINGS_REFERENCE=1 cargo test -p stem-core --test settings_reference
```

In PowerShell, set the variable with `$env:STEM_UPDATE_SETTINGS_REFERENCE = '1'`
first and remove it afterwards with `Remove-Item Env:STEM_UPDATE_SETTINGS_REFERENCE`.
The check scripts (`scripts/check-all.sh` and `scripts/check-all.ps1`) and
CI fail while the page is out of date.

The [user guide](user-guide/settings-window.md) says where the file lives,
which part of the settings window sets each key, and how the dock behaves.

A dotted key such as `magnification.maxScale` is the `maxScale` key inside the
`magnification` object, and `pinned[]` stands for each entry of the `pinned`
array.

A key missing from the file takes its default, a key that this page does not
list is ignored, and a number outside its documented range is clamped to the
nearest end of it. The whole file is unreadable when it is not valid JSON, or
when it has one of these values:

- a value of the wrong JSON type, such as `"48"` for a number, `"true"` for a
  boolean or `null` for an object;
- a string that is not one of the key's listed values;
- for an integer key, a negative number, a number with a decimal point (even
  `48.0`) or one above `4294967295`;
- a `pinned[]` or `hiddenApps[]` entry without one of its required keys;
- a `version` higher than the one this build of Stem writes.

Stem then keeps the file as `settings.json.broken` and starts with the
defaults; see the [user guide](user-guide/settings-window.md).

## Top level

The whole settings document, as stored in `settings.json`.

| Key             | Type                                                | Default     | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| --------------- | --------------------------------------------------- | ----------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `version`       | integer                                             | `1`         | Format version of the document. Stem writes the version it supports. A document with a lower version is upgraded when it loads, and a document with a higher version is unreadable.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `position`      | `"bottom"`, `"left"`, `"right"` or `"top"`          | `"bottom"`  | Screen edge the dock is on. A change applies at once: the dock windows move to the new edge.<br>`"bottom"`: Bottom edge, as a row centred on it (the default).<br>`"left"`: Left edge, as a column centred on it. Magnified icons grow towards the middle of the screen, and the name tooltips appear beside them.<br>`"right"`: Right edge, as a column centred on it. Magnified icons grow towards the middle of the screen, and the name tooltips appear beside them.<br>`"top"`: Top edge, as a row centred on it. |
| `iconSize`      | integer, 24 to 128                                  | `48`        | Base icon size in CSS pixels, before magnification.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `magnification` | object, see [`magnification`](#magnification)       | per key     | Magnification of icons near the cursor.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `autoHide`      | object, see [`autoHide`](#autohide)                 | per key     | When and how the dock hides itself.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `monitors`      | `"primary"` or `"all"`                              | `"primary"` | Which monitors get a dock. A change applies at once: Stem opens or closes the docks of the other monitors, and the primary monitor's dock stays.<br>`"primary"`: One dock, on the primary monitor.<br>`"all"`: One dock per monitor.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `theme`         | `"system"`, `"light"` or `"dark"`                   | `"system"`  | Light or dark colours for the dock and the settings window.<br>`"system"`: Follow the Windows app mode, light or dark (`ThemeInfo.dark`).<br>`"light"`: Always light.<br>`"dark"`: Always dark.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `appearance`    | object, see [`appearance`](#appearance)             | per key     | How the dock looks: theme preset, opacity, corner radius, backdrop, tooltips and the launch bounce.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `items`         | object, see [`items`](#items)                       | per key     | Which fixed items (the items that are not apps) the dock shows.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `behavior`      | object, see [`behavior`](#behavior)                 | per key     | What clicks, the mouse wheel and the global shortcuts do, and which windows the dock lists.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `pinned`        | array of objects, see [`pinned[]`](#pinned)         | `[]`        | Pinned apps, in dock order: left to right, or top to bottom on a dock at the left or right edge. Entries whose id is empty or only whitespace are dropped, and of several entries with the same id only the first stays.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `hiddenApps`    | array of objects, see [`hiddenApps[]`](#hiddenapps) | `[]`        | Apps the dock does not show while they run. *Hide from Stem* in a running app's menu adds one, and *Show* on the settings page removes it. A listed app gets no item on any dock, but its windows still count for everything else: the foreground window, fullscreen detection and the overlap test of auto-hide. A pinned app is never hidden, so an entry whose id is pinned is dropped. Entries whose id is empty or only whitespace are dropped too, and of several entries with the same id only the first stays. |
| `system`        | object, see [`system`](#system)                     | per key     | Windows integration: start at sign-in, the stock taskbar, reserved screen space and the log file.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |

## `magnification`

Icon magnification near the cursor.

| Key                        | Type               | Default | Description                                                     |
| -------------------------- | ------------------ | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `magnification.enabled`    | boolean            | `true`  | Magnify icons as the cursor comes near them.                    |
| `magnification.maxScale`   | number, 1.0 to 2.5 | `1.6`   | Scale of the icon directly under the cursor.                    |
| `magnification.rangeIcons` | integer, 1 to 6    | `3`     | How many neighbouring icons on each side of that icon grow too. |

## `autoHide`

Auto-hide: when the dock hides itself, and how long it waits.

| Key                | Type                                      | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| ------------------ | ----------------------------------------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `autoHide.mode`    | `"off"`, `"always"` or `"whenOverlapped"` | `"off"` | Whether and when the dock hides. Whatever the mode, a fullscreen app hides the dock of its monitor.<br>`"off"`: The dock stays on screen.<br>`"always"`: The dock hides whenever the cursor leaves it, and comes back when the cursor touches the dock's screen edge.<br>`"whenOverlapped"`: The dock hides only while a window of another program overlaps the panel, and comes back as soon as none does. |
| `autoHide.delayMs` | integer, 0 to 5000                        | `250`   | How long the dock waits before it hides, in milliseconds. The wait starts when the cursor leaves the dock, or when a window starts to overlap it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |

## `appearance`

How the dock looks.

| Key                         | Type                                   | Default      | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| --------------------------- | -------------------------------------- | ------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `appearance.theme`          | `"standard"`, `"solid"` or `"minimal"` | `"standard"` | Theme preset of the panel. A change restyles the dock at once.<br>`"standard"`: A translucent, blurred panel with a thin outline and a soft shadow (the default). `opacity` sets how translucent it is.<br>`"solid"`: An opaque panel without blur, with a stronger outline and a tighter shadow. It is easy to read over any wallpaper, and the best choice while Windows' *Transparency effects* are off.<br>`"minimal"`: No panel fill, outline or shadow: only the icons, the running dots and the separators.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `appearance.opacity`        | number, 0.0 to 1.0                     | `0.72`       | Panel background opacity of the `standard` theme. The `solid` panel is always opaque, and the `minimal` one has no fill.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `appearance.cornerRadius`   | integer, 0 to 64                       | `22`         | Panel corner radius in CSS pixels.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `appearance.backdrop`       | `"css"`, `"acrylic"` or `"mica"`       | `"css"`      | Backdrop material behind the panel.<br>`"css"`: A translucent CSS background only. It works on every Windows version and on every dock.<br>`"acrylic"`: The acrylic material of DWM (the Desktop Window Manager, which draws the windows on screen) behind the panel. Experimental, and the settings page does not offer it. On Windows 11 22H2 or later, a native window under the primary dock's panel shows the material (a prototype). On older Windows versions, under a contrast theme and on every secondary dock, the panel draws the `css` backdrop instead.<br>`"mica"`: The mica material of DWM behind the panel. Experimental, and the settings page does not offer it. On Windows 11 22H2 or later, a native window under the primary dock's panel shows the material (a prototype). On older Windows versions, under a contrast theme and on every secondary dock, the panel draws the `css` backdrop instead. |
| `appearance.tooltips`       | boolean                                | `true`       | Show an item's name in a tooltip while the cursor is over the item or the item has the keyboard focus.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `appearance.bounceOnLaunch` | boolean                                | `true`       | Bounce the icon of an app that the dock launched while the app starts. No icon bounces while Windows' *Animation effects* are off.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |

## `items`

Which fixed items (the items that are not apps) the dock shows. The items at the left come before the apps and the items at the right come after them; on a dock at the left or right edge, left means the top and right means the bottom.

| Key                        | Type    | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| -------------------------- | ------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `items.launcher`           | boolean | `true`  | The Start item at the left, which opens the Start menu.                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `items.taskView`           | boolean | `false` | The Task View item at the left.                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `items.showDesktop`        | boolean | `false` | The Show Desktop item at the left.                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `items.quickSettings`      | boolean | `false` | The Quick Settings item at the right, before the Recycle Bin. A click opens what Win+A opens.                                                                                                                                          |
| `items.notificationCenter` | boolean | `false` | The Notification Center item at the right, before the Recycle Bin. A click opens what Win+N opens.                                                                                                                                     |
| `items.volume`             | boolean | `false` | The volume item at the right, after Notification Center. It shows the volume of the default output device. A click opens what Win+A opens, and the mouse wheel over it changes the volume, whatever `behavior.scrollAction` is set to. |
| `items.battery`            | boolean | `false` | The battery item at the right, after the volume. It appears only on a PC with a battery. A click opens what Win+A opens.                                                                                                               |
| `items.clock`              | boolean | `false` | The clock item at the right, after the battery. A click opens what Win+N opens.                                                                                                                                                        |
| `items.recycleBin`         | boolean | `true`  | The Recycle Bin item, last at the right.                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `items.separators`         | boolean | `true`  | Draw thin separators between the item groups: the items at the left, the pinned apps, the other running apps and the items at the right.                                                                                               |

## `behavior`

What clicks, the mouse wheel and the global shortcuts do, and which windows the dock lists.

| Key                               | Type                         | Default              | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| --------------------------------- | ---------------------------- | -------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `behavior.clickActiveMinimizes`   | boolean                      | `true`               | A click on the icon of the app in front minimises its window when the app has one window. Off, the click brings that window to the front again. When the app in front has several windows, the click brings its next window to the front, whatever this setting.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `behavior.showOnlyCurrentDesktop` | boolean                      | `true`               | Hide windows that are on another virtual desktop.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `behavior.showOnlyCurrentMonitor` | boolean                      | `false`              | Each monitor's dock shows only the windows on that monitor.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `behavior.runningIndicators`      | boolean                      | `true`               | Show the dots between a running app's icon and the screen edge.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `behavior.clickThrough`           | boolean                      | `true`               | Let clicks outside the panel reach the desktop and the windows behind the dock. The dock window spans the whole length of its screen edge, so with this off the whole dock window takes every click, including on its empty part. Off is meant for diagnosis, not as a preference.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `behavior.toggleShortcut`         | string                       | `"Ctrl+Alt+D"`       | Global keyboard shortcut that shows or hides the dock from any app, like a left click on the tray icon. It is written as modifiers first, then one key, joined by `+`, such as `Ctrl+Alt+D`; letter case does not matter. The modifiers are `Ctrl`, `Alt`, `Shift` and `Super` (the Windows key). The keys are `A`..`Z`, `0`..`9`, `F1`..`F24`, `Space`, `Enter`, `Tab`, `Up`, `Down`, `Left`, `Right`, `Home`, `End`, `PageUp`, `PageDown`, `Insert`, `Delete` and punctuation such as `,` or `/`. Unless the key is one of `F1`..`F24`, the shortcut needs `Ctrl`, `Alt` or `Super`, so that ordinary typing never triggers it. Empty means no shortcut. A value that Stem cannot register (an unknown key, or one another app already holds) is kept as written, but no shortcut is active and the log has a warning. |
| `behavior.focusShortcut`          | string                       | `"Ctrl+Alt+Shift+D"` | Global keyboard shortcut that moves the keyboard focus into the dock from any app, like Win+T for the stock taskbar. The arrow keys then move from item to item, Enter or Space opens the focused one, and Escape (or the shortcut again) goes back to the window that was in front. The dock on that window's monitor receives the focus, or the primary monitor's dock when that monitor has no dock. Same format and rules as `toggleShortcut`. A value equal to `toggleShortcut`, ignoring case and modifier order, is not registered, and the toggle shortcut keeps those keys. Empty means no shortcut.                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `behavior.scrollAction`           | `"none"` or `"cycleWindows"` | `"none"`             | What turning the mouse wheel over an app's icon does. A change applies at once.<br>`"none"`: The wheel does nothing (the default).<br>`"cycleWindows"`: Over an app with open windows, each wheel notch brings the app's next window to the front (wheel turned towards you) or its previous one (turned away). After the last window comes the first again, and a minimised window is restored. The dock switches windows at most once every 150 ms. Only the windows that this dock lists take part, as for a click.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |

## `pinned[]`

An app pinned to the dock.

| Key               | Type                                           | Default  | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ----------------- | ---------------------------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `pinned[].id`     | string                                         | required | Must match the id Stem gives the app's windows, so that the pin and the running windows share one item: `exe:` followed by the program's path in lower case with forward slashes (`AppId::for_exe`), or `aumid:` followed by the app's AppUserModelID (`AppId::for_app_user_model_id`). An AppUserModelID is the identifier Windows uses to group an app's windows on the taskbar. |
| `pinned[].label`  | string or `null`                               | `null`   | A name that replaces the app's own name on the dock, or `null` to use the app's own name.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `pinned[].launch` | object, see [`pinned[].launch`](#pinnedlaunch) | required | How to start the app when it has no window.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |

## `pinned[].launch`

How to start an application.

| Key                              | Type                                           | Default  | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| -------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `pinned[].launch.kind`           | `"exe"`, `"shortcut"`, `"storeApp"` or `"uri"` | required | Sets which of the other keys apply.<br>`"exe"`: A classic desktop executable.<br>`"shortcut"`: A `.lnk` shortcut. Windows resolves it when Stem launches it, and Stem reads the shortcut to identify the app it starts.<br>`"storeApp"`: A packaged (Store or UWP) app, launched by its AppUserModelID.<br>`"uri"`: Anything that `ShellExecute` can open, such as `ms-settings:`, `shell:AppsFolder` or a web URL. |
| `pinned[].launch.path`           | string                                         | required | Path of the executable. Only when `kind` is `"exe"`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `pinned[].launch.args`           | array of strings                               | `[]`     | Command-line arguments, one string per argument. Only when `kind` is `"exe"`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `pinned[].launch.workingDir`     | string or `null`                               | `null`   | Working directory to start the app in, or `null` to start it in the executable's own folder. Only when `kind` is `"exe"`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `pinned[].launch.path`           | string                                         | required | Path of the `.lnk` file. Only when `kind` is `"shortcut"`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `pinned[].launch.appUserModelId` | string                                         | required | The app's AppUserModelID. Only when `kind` is `"storeApp"`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `pinned[].launch.uri`            | string                                         | required | The URI to open. Only when `kind` is `"uri"`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |

## `hiddenApps[]`

An app the dock does not show while it runs.

| Key                    | Type             | Default  | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| ---------------------- | ---------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `hiddenApps[].id`      | string           | required | The id Stem gives the app's windows, in one of the forms of `pinned[].id`, or `class:` followed by the window class name in lower case for an app known only by its window class (`AppId::for_window_class`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `hiddenApps[].name`    | string           | `""`     | The app's display name when it was hidden. The settings page lists the app by this name.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `hiddenApps[].path`    | string or `null` | `null`   | The path of the app's program when it was hidden, as Windows reported it, or else the `.exe` or `.lnk` file Stem launches the app from. It keeps its original case, while an `exe:` id has the path in lower case. The settings page shows it under the name. `null` when Stem did not know a path (for an app known only by its window class, or a Store app), or when the entry has no `path` key.                                                             |
| `hiddenApps[].iconKey` | string or `null` | `null`   | The icon the app's item showed when it was hidden. The settings page draws it beside the name. Stem never stores the icon of a single window (which an item shows when Windows does not let Stem read the app's own icon), because that icon means nothing once the window is gone; it stores the icon of the file in `path` instead, when `path` is known. `null` when Stem knew neither an icon of the app nor a path, or when the entry has no `iconKey` key. |

## `system`

Windows integration settings.

| Key                         | Type    | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| --------------------------- | ------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `system.autostart`          | boolean | `false` | Start Stem when the user signs in.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `system.hideWindowsTaskbar` | boolean | `false` | Hide the stock Windows taskbar while Stem runs, by turning on Windows' own *Automatically hide the taskbar* option. Turning this off, or quitting Stem, sets that option back to what it was.                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `system.reserveScreenSpace` | boolean | `false` | Register each dock window as an AppBar (an application desktop toolbar: Windows takes a band at the dock's screen edge out of the work area, as it does for the stock taskbar), so that maximised windows end at the dock instead of going under it. This works only while `autoHide.mode` is `off`: an auto-hiding dock reserves nothing. A change applies at once. |
| `system.fileLogging`        | boolean | `true`  | Write a log file, `stem.log`, in Stem's `logs` folder under `%LOCALAPPDATA%`. Stem reads this setting when it starts, so a change applies after a restart.                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
